gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: We couldn't find the museum anywhere.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere + auxiliary + subject: Nowhere could we find the museum.

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.sentence: Travel is ___ if you go off-peak.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: He finally managed to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.
